{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Different Shades Of Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Blues guitar fits my recent listening, and this is one I would choose today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Best: Loggins & Messina Sittin' In Again; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The classic roots-rock sound appeals, but I am more interested in blues right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My interest in Old Sock makes this relaxed blues tribute especially appealing; I would try it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Supernova; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This is less clearly connected to the blues and classic rock I want today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotic Eye; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: It feels like a natural next listen after You Should Be So Lucky, so I would choose it.
ItemID: NA; Title: In Session At Paradise Studio; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The rootsy session setting interests me, but I would start with The Breeze.
ItemID: NA; Title: Gary Clark Jr. Live; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Live blues guitar fits my interest in Hendrix, but I would save it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Roots; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The roots-oriented material sounds compatible with my listening, though it is not my first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lost on the River: The New Basement Tapes; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The roots-rock direction interests me, but I am only choosing a few stronger matches.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Lumineers; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Folk-pop is less appealing than blues guitar and classic rock for my current mood."}
